title: Emerald Pack Expansion
description: Adds full sets of emerald armor and tools. Includes custom trading with villagers and a unique advancement system.
body:
**Overview** This mod expands the utility of emeralds by introducing a complete set of gear. No longer just a currency, emeralds can now be crafted into powerful equipment that sits between Diamond and Netherite in terms of durability and efficiency.

**Key Features:**

**Emerald Armor:** A full set providing high protection and a stylish green look.

**Tools & Weapons:** Includes the Emerald Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.

**Villager Integration:** Get these items through high-level trading with specialized villagers.

**Custom Advancements:** Track your progress with a unique advancement tree specifically designed for this pack.

**Technical Information:**

**Version:** 1.21.1

**Loader:** NeoForge
